englishOnly.description: Show specialised English models with higher accuracy for English transcription.

manage.description: Delete cached models to free up disk space.
manage.confirmBody: This will delete the {{model}} model from your device. If you use this model in future it will need to be downloaded again.

diarize.label: Speaker Diarization Model
diarize.details: Used for speaker diarization and labeling.

aligner.label: MMS Forced Alignment Model
aligner.details: Optional model that aligns transcript words to the original speech.
aligner.attribution: Meta MMS model · upstream conversion by MahmoudAshraf · ONNX conversion by onnx-community

tiny.label: Whisper Tiny
tiny.details: Fastest transcription with minimal memory. Ideal for quick drafts.

tiny_en.label: Whisper Tiny
tiny_en.details: Fastest English transcription with minimal memory. Ideal for quick drafts.

base.label: Whisper Base
base.details: Reliable transcription with low memory requirements. Great for everyday use.

base_en.label: Whisper Base
base_en.details: Reliable English transcription with low memory. Great for everyday use.

small.label: Whisper Small
small.details: Balanced speed and accuracy with moderate memory. Handles varied accents well.

small_en.label: Whisper Small
small_en.details: Balanced speed and English accuracy with moderate memory. Handles varied accents.

medium.label: Whisper Medium
medium.details: High accuracy transcription with moderate speed and memory. Good for challenging audio.

medium_en.label: Whisper Medium
medium_en.details: High accuracy English transcription with moderate speed. Good for challenging audio.

large_v3_turbo.label: Whisper Large Turbo
large_v3_turbo.details: Excellent accuracy with faster speed than Large model and moderate memory.

large_v3.label: Whisper Large
large_v3.details: Highest accuracy for complex audio, but slower and requires significant memory.

parakeet.label: Parakeet
parakeet.details: Excellent accuracy and speed for European languages.

moonshine_tiny.label: Moonshine Tiny
moonshine_tiny.details: Extremely fast on-device English transcription with minimal resources. Ideal for real-time use.

moonshine_tiny_ar.label: Moonshine Tiny
moonshine_tiny_ar.details: Fast on-device Arabic transcription with minimal resources.

moonshine_tiny_zh.label: Moonshine Tiny
moonshine_tiny_zh.details: Fast on-device Chinese transcription with minimal resources.

moonshine_tiny_ja.label: Moonshine Tiny
moonshine_tiny_ja.details: Fast on-device Japanese transcription with minimal resources.

moonshine_tiny_ko.label: Moonshine Tiny
moonshine_tiny_ko.details: Fast on-device Korean transcription with minimal resources.

moonshine_tiny_uk.label: Moonshine Tiny
moonshine_tiny_uk.details: Fast on-device Ukrainian transcription with minimal resources.

moonshine_tiny_vi.label: Moonshine Tiny
moonshine_tiny_vi.details: Fast on-device Vietnamese transcription with minimal resources.

moonshine_base.label: Moonshine Base
moonshine_base.details: Fast on-device English transcription with better accuracy than Moonshine Tiny.

moonshine_base_es.label: Moonshine Base
moonshine_base_es.details: Fast on-device Spanish transcription with good accuracy.

sense_voice.label: SenseVoice
sense_voice.details: Strong accuracy for Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean and Cantonese.

canary.label: Canary
canary.details: Understands context and supports translation, 25 languages.

cohere.label: Cohere
cohere.details: Large multilingual transcription model from Cohere.

gigaam_v3.label: GigaAM v3
gigaam_v3.details: Trained on 700k hours of Russian speech, with punctuation and text normalization. The most accurate option for Russian.

gigaam_multilingual.label: GigaAM Multilingual
gigaam_multilingual.details: Best open quality for Kazakh, Kyrgyz and Uzbek, and strong on Russian. Outputs lowercase text without punctuation.

omni_asr_1b_ctc.label: Omni-ASR
omni_asr_1b_ctc.details: Larger and more accurate multilingual model for 1600+ languages. Outputs lowercase text without punctuation or capitalization.

language.label: Language
language.bothHint: The source language goes on a new track.

support.title: Support AutoSubs
support.description: Choose how you'd like to support AutoSubs development.

coffee.title: Buy me a coffee?
coffee.description: If AutoSubs has saved you time, consider buying me a coffee to support the project!

modePicker.title: Choose a workspace
modePicker.subtitle: Pick the tool you want to open. You can switch anytime.

autocut.noTimeline: No timeline detected. Open DaVinci Resolve, run Workspace → Scripts → AutoSubs, then open a timeline with a video and an audio track.
autocut.fillers: Cut filler words (um, uh, à, ừm)
autocut.fillersHint: Transcribes the audio to find and remove filler words. Slower.
autocut.keepCopy: Keep the original (cut onto a new timeline)
autocut.keepCopyHint: Off: cut this timeline in place (undoable). On: build the cut onto a new timeline and leave this one alone.
autocut.minKeepHint: Speech shorter than this is treated as noise (a breath, a click) and cut too.
autocut.minSilenceHint: Pauses shorter than this are left alone, so natural beats between sentences survive.
autocut.padBeforeHint: Extra audio kept before each phrase, so speech doesn't start the instant the cut lands.
autocut.padAfterHint: Extra audio kept after each phrase, so the last word isn't clipped short.

target.noneSelected: Select an audio track — silences are found in the sound, so there is nothing to analyse without one.
target.videoHint: Video tracks to cut. They follow the first selected audio track, since picture has no sound of its own to measure.
target.audioHint: Audio tracks to cut. Each one is analysed and cut on its own, so their lengths will end up different.

autoedit.title: AutoEdit
autoedit.description: Run Python-powered edit scripts inside DaVinci Resolve — cut, arrange, and automate your timeline.

myScripts.title: My scripts
myScripts.description: Import a .py once and it stays here to run again on the open timeline.
myScripts.empty: No scripts yet. Import a .py file to keep it here for next time.

import.title: Run a Python script
import.description: Pick a .py file and run it against the currently open DaVinci Resolve timeline.
import.dropHint: Or drag and drop a .py file here
import.logEmpty: The script's stdout and stderr will appear here.

builtin.title: Built-in scripts
builtin.description: Handcrafted scripts bundled with the app. Click Run to try one on the currently open Resolve timeline.
builtin.empty: No built-in scripts yet. Add one to your library to see it here.

resolveInfo.name: Resolve info
resolveInfo.description: Read-only. Prints project and timeline stats to the log.

addMarker.name: Add marker at playhead
addMarker.description: Adds a blue marker at the current playhead. Undo with Ctrl/Cmd+Z inside Resolve.

chapters.name: YouTube chapters
chapters.description: Turns your timeline markers into a chapter list you can paste straight into a video description.

markCuts.name: Mark every clip cut
markCuts.description: Drops a cyan marker on each clip boundary of video track 1, so you can review cut to cut.

clearMarkers.name: Clear all markers
clearMarkers.description: Removes every marker from the timeline. Undo with Ctrl/Cmd+Z inside Resolve.

subtitleMarkers.name: Markers from subtitles
subtitleMarkers.description: One marker per subtitle, carrying its text — the marker list becomes a clickable transcript index.

speechGaps.name: Find long pauses
speechGaps.description: Marks every silence of 2s or more between subtitles: dead air to tighten, or where a new section starts.

timelineGaps.name: Check for gaps
timelineGaps.description: Finds holes in video track 1 that would play as black, and marks each one red.

silenceCut.name: Auto-cut silences
silenceCut.description: Detects silences on the audio track, duplicates the timeline, and rebuilds it without the pauses.

slideshow.name: Slideshow from voice
slideshow.description: Place a batch of images or clips onto the timeline, each timed to the sentence it belongs to in the transcribed voice-over.

mcp.title: MCP integration
mcp.description: Expose Resolve as an MCP server so agents like Claude or Cursor can drive your timeline.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.description: Guides and walkthroughs for building your own AutoEdit scripts.
tutorial.empty: The tutorial article will live here.

status.readyForScripts: Ready to run scripts on this timeline.

setup.title: Setting up AutoEdit
setup.description: Downloading the Python runtime AutoEdit uses to talk to DaVinci Resolve. This only happens once.

options.minPauseHint: Only silences at least this long are marked. Lower finds more, higher finds only the big breaks.
options.minSilenceCutHint: Silences shorter than this stay. 0.5 to 1.0 is a good starting point.
options.silencePaddingHint: Extra breath kept on each side of a kept span, so words are not clipped.
options.noAudioTracks: No audio tracks. Open DaVinci Resolve, run Workspace → Scripts → AutoSubs, then open a timeline.
options.noVideoTracks: No video tracks. Open DaVinci Resolve, run Workspace → Scripts → AutoSubs, then open a timeline.
options.noSubtitleTracks: No subtitle track on this timeline. Generate subtitles with AutoSubs first.

autosub.title: AutoSubs
autosub.description: Transcribe your timeline audio and generate styled captions with Whisper.

slideshow.scriptError: Could not read the script file.

slideshow.allPlaced: Every clip is already on the timeline.

link.trimTimelineHint: Keeps the whole file so you can re-trim later.
link.trimDownloadHint: Faster and smaller, but cuts on keyframes so the start can drift.
link.toolsMissing: Open the Download tab once to install the downloader.

download.title: Download video
download.subtitle: Paste a video link and save an MP4.
download.trimHint: Leave both empty to download the whole video.
download.batch: Batch download (.txt, one URL per line)
download.batchHint: Every link in the file downloads at best quality. The single URL and trim above are ignored.

setup.title: Setting up the downloader
setup.subtitle: A one-time download of yt-dlp and a small JavaScript runtime so every video can be fetched.

update.title: The downloader needs updating
update.body: YouTube changes how it serves video every few months. An out-of-date downloader stops working without a clear reason, so update it before downloading.

appUpdate.title: A new version is available
appUpdate.body: This update installs itself and restarts AutoSubs. It only takes a moment.
appUpdate.resolveNote: After the restart, run Workspace → Scripts → AutoSubs again in DaVinci Resolve to reconnect.
